node.statement: By lem-maincb-error-improvement choose a universal valid coefficient c0 and, using monotonicity of the defining defect inequalities, enlarge it so c0 >= 1. Then by lem-maincb-direct-corner-envelope choose corresponding universal witnesses L^0,e_env^0, enlarging L^0 if necessary so L^0 >= max{1,c0}; finally fix the universal C_cross^0,e_cross^0 supplied by lem-maincb-cross-class-merging-datum for these prior choices.
